welcome.title: Middle taps
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Middle taps
sections.intro: Hold your hand up in front of you, palm away, and point it at the lit button, as if a laser came out of your knuckles (Frametop's hand ray). When it lights up purple, tap thumb to middle fingertip, the index out of the way: a right click. Nothing happens when you tap: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand up in front of you, palm away, the left one down and out of view.|Point the hand at each button as it lights and middle tap. Start with the arm nearly straight.

switch.to: elbow bent, hand near your chest

prompts.text: Left hand up in front of you, palm away, the right one down and out of view.|Point it at each lit button and middle tap. Start with the elbow bent, the hand near your chest.
Two windows, left and right: the lit button jumps between them.|Point your right hand at it and middle tap, keeping your head facing ahead.

switch.to: turning your head to each one too

prompts.text: One window high, one low. Point your left hand at the lit button and middle tap,|the hand going up and down with it.
A big window far away: small moves of the hand aim across it.|Right hand up, palm away: point and middle tap.
Both hands up, palms away. Each lit button says L or R:|point that hand at it and middle tap.
Right hand pointing. A button showing 2: a double middle tap. A button showing hold: press and keep it until it goes out, as if dragging.
Right hand pointing. Cyan: tap with the index. Purple: tap with the middle finger.|Telling the two apart is the point: make each one clear.
Left hand pointing. Cyan: index tap. Purple: middle tap.
Right hand pointing. Purple: middle tap. Orange with a cross: don't touch, stop about 1 cm short.|Now and then close the hand slowly into a fist instead.
Your own pace: point at the lit button and middle tap as often as you like.|Move the arm while you do: straight out, bent, out to the side, higher and lower.

says.middle: Your own pace: middle tap it as often as you like
